verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains verbatim text captured from CIPO's public trademarks, patents and landing pages, such as filing guidance, wait-time forecasts and database links. That suggests the published guidance surface returned readable content, and cipo-supp-2 notes that public patent search is keyless. However, no item states how the pages were fetched or confirms the absence of bot walls, CAPTCHA or JS-only shells. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of fetch conditions (identified user agent, no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, server-rendered HTML rather than a JS shell), coverage of deeper guidance pages beyond the hub pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
